docs.title: ChatBug 文档
docs.text:
ChatBug 是 ChatArch 系列的授权网站漏洞验证包。当前首个能力聚焦 PHP2Shell：对自有普通网站做安全暴露检查，并在无真实数据的一次性 lab 中复现“运行时 + LFI gadget → session upload-progress 注入 → ls/cat 输出”的完整验收链。

站点入口：https://arch.gh.wzhecnu.cn/ChatBug/

docs.title: 按场景选择文档
docs.text: 场景 文档 查看完整命令、选项和退出码 CLI 树 理解能力状态、证据层级和安全边界 能力地图 从 Python 代码调用检查或 lab API Python 接口树 跑通本机或 PHP-FPM/Nginx 隔离复现实验 PHP2Shell 复现实验

docs.title: 最快开始
docs.text:
python -m pip install ChatBug
chatbug --tree
chatbug php2shell lab local-list

local-list 不需要 Docker、root、网络或真实 shell；它用进程内 HTTP lab 同时验证正向 include sink 和负向普通入口。

docs.title: 核心结论
docs.text:
• web check <URL> 是非破坏性自有网站检查：版本暴露、multipart 可达性和固定 gadget 探测必须分层报告。
  • lab local-list 是确定性的本机教学/CI 用例。
  • lab docker-list --ssh-host <host> 在 internal-only Docker lab 中用 exact/digest-pinned PHP-FPM 运行时证明固定 ls/cat，不挂生产数据，不发布端口。
  • ChatBug 不发送 OOM/UAF/崩溃 payload，不提供任意命令或 reverse shell，不把版本暴露直接宣称为 RCE。

docs.title: 文档状态约定
docs.text:
• 已实现：代码、测试和 CLI 路径已经存在。
  • 已验证：已经通过本地测试、CI 或一次性隔离 lab 验证。
  • 不提供：明确属于安全边界外，例如生产内存破坏利用或任意命令框架。

docs.title: 本地开发预览
docs.text:
python -m pip install -e ".[dev,docs]"
python -m pytest -q
mkdocs serve

英文入口：https://arch.gh.wzhecnu.cn/ChatBug/en/。缺少英文翻译的专题页会通过 i18n fallback 回退到默认语言。

docs.title: 能力地图
docs.text: ChatBug 当前聚焦一个窄而可验收的安全能力：在明确授权范围内验证 PHP 网站的 PHP2Shell 风险。它把“版本暴露”和“端到端命令/文件读取证明”分开处理。

docs.title: 一等能力
docs.text:
• 普通网站安全检查

    chatbug php2shell web check <URL> 面向普通自有网站，不为 Mail 单独设计 CLI 入口。检查 PHP 版本暴露、multipart parser 可达性和固定常见 LFI 参数形态。

  • 本机可重复实验

    chatbug php2shell lab local-list 在进程内启动临时 HTTP lab，无 Docker、无 root、无系统 shell，用正/负向测试展示 session upload-progress + include gadget 链。

  • 完整运行时隔离实验

    chatbug php2shell lab docker-list 在自有 Docker 主机上创建 internal-only、一次性、无生产数据的 PHP-FPM/Nginx lab，并用固定 ls/cat allowlist 验收。

  • 可导入 Python API

    CLI 保持薄入口；版本分类、HTTP 检查、payload 构造、lab 生命周期都可从 Python 模块导入和测试。

docs.title: 能力状态
docs.text: 能力 状态 证据边界 PHP 版本头解析和修复版本分类 已实现并验证 只证明版本/配置暴露，不证明可利用 普通 multipart parser reachability 检查 已实现并验证 只证明请求能到达上传进度解析路径 固定常见 LFI marker 探测 已实现并验证 只有独立 marker 从服务端返回才证明文件读取 本机 LFI/session 注入 lab 已实现并验证 确定性教学链；不运行真实 shell，不模拟内存破坏 远端同运行时 Docker lab 已实现并验证 证明“运行时 + 故意加入的应用 LFI gadget”可走到固定 ls/cat CVE-2026-109618/109619 内存破坏 RCE 利用 未实现 不发送 OOM/UAF payload；需要另行授权和专门内存利用研究 生产服务利用测试 不默认提供 生产含真实数据，默认只做安全检查；内存破坏利用不在包内自动执行 任意命令执行框架 / reverse shell 不提供 docker-list 仅接受三个固定 proof 值

docs.title: 实战例子如何映射到产品
docs.text:
一次真实 PHP webmail 风险评估可以拆成两层：

  1. 把它视为普通 PHP 网站运行 web check：确认实际 HTTP SAPI 暴露的 PHP 版本和 multipart 入口，而不是因为服务类型另建一个 mail 专用命令；
  2. 若需要 ls/cat 级验收，在 --fpm-image 指定的相同 PHP-FPM 运行时镜像上运行 docker-list：lab 挂载合成 webroot 和随机 marker，不连接真实邮箱、数据库或附件卷。

因此，“这是 Mail 服务”只影响选择相相同 PHP-FPM 运行时镜像，不改变通用 CLI 模型。

docs.title: 安全设计约束
docs.text:
• 所有远程检查必须针对自有或已授权目标。
  • 生产检查默认无 OOM、无 UAF、无崩溃、无暴力重复、无任意命令。
  • Marker 不放进用于读取验证的 URL、query 或 traversal 字符串，避免输入反射误判。
  • 正向和负向结果必须同时成立：有 include sink 时返回 marker；普通安全入口只返回 Hello World。
  • Docker lab 使用内部网络、唯一 Compose project、合成数据和自动清理；--keep 只供短时人工复查。
  • 报告必须明确写出“runtime only”与“runtime + gadget”的区别。

docs.title: 不在当前范围
docs.text:
• 不扫描互联网或未授权主机。
  • 不读取真实用户邮件、会话、附件、密钥或生产临时文件。
  • 不重启、修补、下架或重新配置生产服务。
  • 不隐藏版本 banner 后宣称已修复；修复仍应以运行时版本和实际发布工件为准。
  • 不把 scanner 结论、docker exec 管理面执行、普通 PHP 页面执行误报为未授权 RCE。

docs.title: CLI 树
docs.text: ChatBug 的命令行是授权漏洞验证入口。以下命令树来自真实 Click 注册面；发布前用 chatbug --tree 回读，不手写未实现命令。

docs.title: 真实命令树
docs.text:
chatbug
├── --help                                                                 # Show this message and exit.
├── --version                                                              # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree                                                                 # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
├── --tree-brief                                                           # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.
└── php2shell                                                              # PHP2Shell web checks and data-free lab proof.
    ├── lab                                                                # Disposable, data-free lab workflows.
    │   ├── docker-list --ssh-host TEXT --fpm-image TEXT --proof [list-tmp|cat-marker|list-and-marker] [--keep]  # Prove list/cat inside a data-free PHP-FPM lab with an intentional include sink.
    │   └── local-list                                                     # Run a complete positive/negative example in an in-process local lab.
    └── web                                                                # Checks for an ordinary owned website URL.
        └── check <URL> [--skip-multipart] [--skip-gadget-scan]            # Check version exposure, parser reachability, and common include gadgets.

docs.title: chatbug php2shell web check <URL>
docs.text:
对一个自己拥有或已获授权的普通网站 URL 做非破坏性检查：

  1. 读取 Server / X-Powered-By 中的 PHP 版本并按修复版本分类；
  2. 发送一个普通 multipart POST，仅证明上传解析入口可达；
  3. 用固定、小规模的常见 page/file/include/path 参数形态检查服务端是否能返回独立 marker；
  4. 输出 JSON，不发送 OOM/UAF/崩溃 payload，不在目标上执行系统命令。

退出码：

  • 0：版本头显示处于受影响范围；
  • 3：检查完成但版本未证明受影响或版本头不可见；
  • 非 0/3：请求或本地执行错误。

常用选项：

  • --skip-multipart：只做版本/HTTP 检查；
  • --skip-gadget-scan：跳过常见 include gadget 探测，只保留版本和 parser reachability。

docs.title: chatbug php2shell lab local-list
docs.text:
在当前进程内启动一个临时 HTTP lab，完整跑正/负向用例：

  • 正向：合成的 LFI include sink 读取 session upload-progress 内容，并返回 /tmp、chatbug-marker.txt 和随机 marker；
  • 负向：普通 hello.php 即使带相同路径参数也只返回 Hello World；
  • 不需要 Docker、root、网络或真实 shell，适合 CI、文档示例和首轮教学复现。

docs.title: chatbug php2shell lab docker-list --ssh-host <host> [--fpm-image <image>]
docs.text:
在自有 SSH Docker 主机上创建一次性完整运行时 lab：

  • 可配置的精确 PHP-FPM 镜像（默认 php:8.1.34-fpm-alpine，也可传生产同版本 digest-pinned 镜像）+ Nginx；
  • internal Docker network，不发布主机端口；
  • 临时 webroot 只包含 Hello World 和 lab-only include($_GET['page'])；
  • 只挂载合成文件，不挂生产数据库、邮件、用户目录、凭据、日志或附件；
  • 结束时自动删除 Compose 项目、网络和远端临时目录。

--proof 是固定 allowlist，不接受任意命令：

proof lab 内固定动作 验收 list-tmp ls -la /tmp 返回 lab 临时目录列表 cat-marker cat /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt 返回随机合成 marker list-and-marker ls -la /tmp; echo MARKER; cat /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt 同时返回目录列表、MARKER 和随机 marker

--keep 仅用于手动复查；默认必须清理。保留中的 lab 仍没有公网/主机发布端口。

docs.title: 证据解释
docs.text:
• 版本暴露只说明修补优先级，不等于 RCE；
  • multipart 200 只说明 parser reachability；
  • local-list 证明包内确定性的 LFI/session 注入教学链可运行；
  • docker-list 在同一 PHP-FPM 运行时和故意加入的 lab gadget 上证明文件包含可走到固定 ls/cat；
  • 没有单独应用 LFI gadget 时，不应把内存破坏 CVE 宣称为“生产 RCE 已复现”。

docs.title: Python 接口树
docs.text: ChatBug CLI 是薄入口；PHP2Shell 的 HTTP 判断、payload 构造和实验环境生命周期都放在可导入、可测试的 Python 模块中。

docs.title: 包入口
docs.text: from chatbug import __version__

docs.title: 模块树
docs.text:
chatbug
├── cli.py              # Click 命令、参数解析、JSON 退出码；不保存远程状态
├── php2shell.py        # 普通网站安全检查、版本分类、固定 lab payload
├── local_lab.py        # 进程内确定性 HTTP lab，供测试和文档复现
└── lab.py              # 远端一次性 Docker Compose lab 生命周期

docs.title: chatbug.php2shell
docs.text:
from chatbug.php2shell import (
    build_lab_session_payload,
    build_safe_multipart_probe,
    classify_version,
    extract_command_output,
    http_request,
    parse_php_version,
    random_marker,
    safe_url_check,
    scan_common_lfi,
)
接口 用途 安全边界 http_request(url, method=..., headers=..., data=...) 小型无第三方依赖 HTTP 原语 不跟随跳转，限制响应读取大小 parse_php_version(headers) 从 Server / X-Powered-By 解析 PHP 版本 只读响应头 classify_version(version) 按首个修复版本分类 vulnerable/fixed/unknown 不推断隐藏版本后的状态 random_marker() 生成随机非敏感验收 marker marker 不进入读取验证 URL build_safe_multipart_probe(marker) 构造普通 upload-progress multipart 请求 不含 OOM/UAF/崩溃 payload scan_common_lfi(url, sid, marker) 扫描固定常见 include 参数形态 小规模、固定路径、无任意 traversal 输入 safe_url_check(url, ...) 聚合网站版本/parser/gadget 证据 返回证据层级，不声称已 RCE build_lab_session_payload(sid, proof) 构造隔离 lab 的固定 session payload proof 只允许三个 allowlist 模式 extract_command_output(body) 提取 lab 正/负向响应中的定界输出 只解析本次合成定界符

典型网站检查：

from chatbug.php2shell import safe_url_check

result = safe_url_check("https://owned-site.example/")
assert result["schema"] == "chatbug.php2shell.web_check/v1"
assert result["rce_or_file_read_proven"] in {True, False}

docs.title: chatbug.local_lab
docs.text:
from chatbug.local_lab import serve_local_lab

serve_local_lab() 是 context manager，启动绑定 127.0.0.1:0 的临时 HTTP 服务：

  • hello.php 固定返回 Hello World；
  • vuln.php 是仅存在于进程内 lab 的 include sink 模拟；
  • 退出 context 后关闭 socket、线程并清空内存 session。

它不启动 PHP、Docker 或系统 shell，适合单元测试和文档中的最小可运行例子。

docs.title: chatbug.lab
docs.text:
from chatbug.lab import LabSpec, logs, run_lfi_proof, seed_marker, start, stop
接口 用途 LabSpec(ssh_host=...) 描述自有 Docker 主机和一次性 lab 配置 start(spec) 写入合成 Compose/webroot 文件并启动 internal lab seed_marker(spec, remote_dir, marker) 在 lab 容器 /tmp 写入随机合成 marker run_lfi_proof(spec, remote_dir, sid, proof) 从内部一次性 client 跑固定正/负向验收 logs(spec, remote_dir) 读取有界日志，用于失败诊断 stop(spec, remote_dir) 删除 Compose 项目和远端临时目录

这些接口只生成合成文件，不接受生产路径或任意远程命令。CLI 的 docker-list 在 finally 中调用清理；只有显式 --keep 才短时保留。

docs.title: 网站检查
docs.text:
chatbug.php2shell.web_check/v1

关键字段：verdict、evidence_tier、rce_or_file_read_proven、findings、multipart、gadget_scan。

docs.title: 本机 lab
docs.text:
chatbug.php2shell.local_lab/v1

关键字段：accepted、post_status、positive_status、negative_status、positive_output、negative_body。

docs.title: Docker lab
docs.text:
chatbug.php2shell.docker_lab/v1

关键字段：accepted、marker、seed、result.positive_output、result.negative_output、cleanup。

docs.title: PHP2Shell 隔离复现实验
docs.text: 本文说明如何用 ChatBug 安全复现“PHP 运行时风险 + 应用 LFI gadget”最终走到 ls/cat 输出的完整链路。例子使用普通网站模型，不为某一个具体业务系统保留专用 CLI。

docs.title: 结论边界
docs.text:
PHP2Shell 相关风险至少要分成两层：

  1. 运行时暴露：HTTP SAPI 使用未修复 PHP 版本，或 multipart/upload-progress 前置路径可达。这说明需要升级和排查，不等于已经能执行命令。
  2. 端到端 gadget：应用还存在攻击者可控制的 include/文件包含入口，能包含 session 文件并执行其中 PHP 代码。隔离 lab 中的 ls/cat 证明的是这一层。

ChatBug 不发送 CVE-2026-109618/109619 的 OOM/UAF/崩溃 payload。远端 lab 复现的是确定性的传统 PHP session upload-progress + LFI 链，并使用与被评估服务相同摘要固定的 PHP-FPM 运行时。

docs.title: 攻击链概览
docs.text:
未认证 multipart POST
  └─ PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS 让 PHP 把请求元数据写入 session 文件
      └─ filename 字段中夹带 <?php ... system(固定命令) ... ?>
          └─ 应用存在 include($user_controlled_path)
              └─ include /tmp/sess_<PHPSESSID>
                  └─ lab 返回 ls/cat 的定界输出

缺少任意一个条件都不能得到同样结论：

  • 没有应用 LFI sink，只能证明运行时/解析入口暴露；
  • 只有 docker exec ... php 是管理面执行，不是未授权利用；
  • 普通 PHP 页面能读文件，也不能证明远程攻击者能执行命令。

docs.title: 1. 本机最小可运行例子
docs.text:
python -m pip install ChatBug
chatbug php2shell lab local-list

该命令：

  • 在当前进程启动一个绑定 127.0.0.1 临时端口的 HTTP lab；
  • 发送 upload-progress multipart 请求；
  • 访问合成的 include sink；
  • 同时访问普通 hello.php 负向入口；
  • 退出时关闭 socket、线程并清空内存状态。

成功结果示例：

{
  "accepted": true,
  "positive_status": 200,
  "negative_status": 200,
  "positive_output": "/tmp\nchatbug-marker.txt\nCHATBUG_MARKER_EXAMPLE",
  "negative_body": "Hello World\n"
}

验收条件：

  • accepted=true；
  • 正向输出包含 /tmp、chatbug-marker.txt 和随机 marker；
  • 负向输出只有 Hello World。

本机 lab 不启动系统 shell，也不启动真实 PHP；它是包内确定性的教学/回归测试。CI 可直接运行：

python -m pytest -q tests/test_php2shell.py

docs.title: 2. 完整 PHP-FPM/Nginx 隔离 lab
docs.text:
在自有 Docker 主机上运行：

chatbug php2shell lab docker-list \
  --ssh-host <owned-docker-host> \
  [--fpm-image <digest-pinned-php-fpm-image>] \
  --proof list-and-marker

ChatBug 会在远端 $HOME/.chatarch/chatbug/labs/ 下创建唯一临时目录，并生成：

  • exact/digest-pinned PHP-FPM 镜像；
  • Nginx 反代到 PHP-FPM；
  • hello.php，只输出 Hello World；
  • vuln.php，仅存在于 lab 中，包含 include($_GET['page'])；
  • upload-progress/session 配置；
  • internal-only Docker network；
  • 一次性 Python client 容器。

不会挂载：生产数据库、邮箱数据、附件、用户目录、凭据、日志或真实 session 目录；也不会发布主机端口。

docs.title: 3. 固定 proof 模式
docs.text:
--proof 不接受任意 shell 命令，只允许：

list-tmp         -> ls -la /tmp
cat-marker       -> cat /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt
list-and-marker  -> ls -la /tmp; echo MARKER; cat /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt

默认 list-and-marker 同时给出目录列举和唯一文件内容，便于区分：

  • 命令确实在 lab 容器内执行；
  • 读到的是服务端 /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt，而不是请求反射。

docs.title: 4. 正/负向验收
docs.text:
成功时，JSON 的 result.positive_output 会包含类似内容：

___START___
total 24
drwxrwxrwt 1 root root 4096 ... .
...
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root 32 ... chatbug-marker.txt
-rw------- 1 www-data www-data ... sess_lab...
MARKER
CHATBUG_MARKER_...
___END___

result.negative_output 必须是：

Hello World

只有同时满足以下条件才标记 accepted=true：

  • POST 返回 200；
  • 正向 include sink 返回 200；
  • 负向普通页面返回 200；
  • 正向输出包含本次随机 marker；
  • 负向输出不包含 marker；
  • Compose 项目和远端临时目录最终成功清理。

docs.title: 5. 普通生产网站检查
docs.text:
对真实服务，只运行安全检查：

chatbug php2shell web check https://owned-service.example/

结果解释：

字段 含义 verdict=vulnerable_version_exposed 版本头显示受影响，需要升级/进一步确认实际 SAPI evidence_tier=tier_2_parser_reachable 普通 multipart 请求能到达解析路径 evidence_tier=tier_3_gadget_found 固定探测返回独立 marker，发现文件包含 gadget 证据 rce_or_file_read_proven=false 尚未证明文件读取或 RCE

该命令不会在生产上执行 ls/cat，也不会发送内存破坏 payload。

docs.title: 6. 复现后的处置建议
docs.text:
1. 盘点所有实际对外服务 HTTP 请求的 PHP SAPI：FPM、mod_php、FrankenPHP、LiteSpeed 等；CLI 版本不能作为 Web 运行时结论。
  2. 升级到官方修复版本，并用新版本 header、包版本或容器 digest 回读。
  3. 搜索并移除应用中的未授权文件包含/路径拼接 sink。
  4. 收紧上传、session 保存路径、临时目录权限和错误暴露。
  5. 升级后重新运行 web check，在同一数据-free lab 中重跑正/负向验收。
  6. 若怀疑已被利用，另行检查访问日志、异常 session、WebShell、子进程和出站连接，不用漏洞验证命令替代取证。

docs.title: ChatBug Docs
docs.text:
ChatBug is an authorized website vulnerability-validation package from the ChatArch series. Its first capability focuses on PHP2Shell: safe exposure checks for ordinary owned websites, plus a disposable data-free lab that reproduces the complete acceptance chain “runtime + LFI gadget → session upload-progress injection → ls/cat output”.

Site entry: https://arch.gh.wzhecnu.cn/ChatBug/en/

docs.title: Choose Documentation by Scenario
docs.text: Scenario Document View complete commands, options, and exit codes CLI Tree Understand capability status, evidence tiers, and safety boundaries Capability Map Call checks or lab APIs from Python Python Interface Tree Run the local or PHP-FPM/Nginx isolated reproduction lab PHP2Shell Reproduction Lab

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
python -m pip install ChatBug
chatbug --tree
chatbug php2shell lab local-list

local-list requires no Docker, root, network, or real shell. It validates the positive include sink and negative normal entry with an in-process HTTP lab.

docs.title: Core Conclusions
docs.text:
• web check <URL> is a non-destructive owned-website check. Version exposure, multipart reachability, and fixed gadget probes are reported as separate evidence tiers.
  • lab local-list is a deterministic local teaching/CI example.
  • lab docker-list --ssh-host <host> proves fixed ls/cat actions with an exact/digest-pinned PHP-FPM runtime in an internal-only Docker lab; it mounts no production data and publishes no port.
  • ChatBug does not send OOM/UAF/crash payloads, provide arbitrary commands or reverse shells, or describe version exposure as RCE.

docs.title: Documentation Status
docs.text:
• Implemented: code, tests, and CLI paths exist.
  • Verified: covered by local tests, CI, or a disposable isolated lab.
  • Not provided: explicitly outside the safety boundary, such as production memory-corruption exploitation or an arbitrary-command framework.

docs.title: Local Development Preview
docs.text:
python -m pip install -e ".[dev,docs]"
python -m pytest -q
mkdocs serve

The Chinese entry is https://arch.gh.wzhecnu.cn/ChatBug/. Topic pages without English translations fall back through i18n to the default language.

docs.title: Capability Map
docs.text: ChatBug currently owns one narrow, acceptance-driven security capability: validating PHP2Shell risk for PHP websites under explicit authorization. It keeps version exposure separate from end-to-end command/file-read proof.

docs.title: First-Class Capabilities
docs.text:
• Ordinary website checks

    chatbug php2shell web check <URL> treats an ordinary owned website as a website; there is no Mail-specific CLI group. It checks PHP version exposure, multipart parser reachability, and fixed common LFI parameter shapes.

  • Local repeatable lab

    chatbug php2shell lab local-list starts an in-process HTTP lab without Docker, root, or a system shell, demonstrating the session upload-progress plus include-gadget chain with positive and negative controls.

  • Full isolated runtime lab

    chatbug php2shell lab docker-list creates an internal-only, one-off, data-free PHP-FPM/Nginx lab on an owned Docker host and accepts fixed ls/cat proof modes.

  • Importable Python API

    The CLI stays thin. Version classification, HTTP checks, payload construction, and lab lifecycle are importable and independently tested.

docs.title: Capability Status
docs.text: Capability Status Evidence boundary PHP version-header parsing and fixed-release classification Implemented and verified Proves version/config exposure only, not exploitability Ordinary multipart parser reachability check Implemented and verified Proves only that a request reaches the upload-progress path Fixed common LFI marker probe Implemented and verified File read is proven only when an independent marker is returned server-side Local LFI/session-injection lab Implemented and verified Deterministic teaching chain; no real shell or memory-corruption simulation Remote same-runtime Docker lab Implemented and verified Proves fixed ls/cat when the vulnerable runtime has an intentionally added application LFI gadget CVE-2026-109618/109619 memory-corruption RCE exploit Not implemented No OOM/UAF payload; requires separate authorization and dedicated exploitation research Production exploitation test Not provided by default Production contains real data; use safe checks by default Arbitrary-command framework / reverse shell Not provided docker-list accepts only three fixed proof values

docs.title: How the Real-World Example Maps to the Product
docs.text:
A real PHP webmail risk assessment splits into two layers:

  1. Treat the service as an ordinary PHP website for web check: identify the PHP version and multipart entry exposed by the actual HTTP SAPI. The service type does not justify a separate mail command.
  2. When ls/cat-level acceptance is needed, run docker-list with --fpm-image set to the same-runtime image. The lab mounts a synthetic webroot and random marker; it never connects to real mailboxes, databases, or attachment volumes.

“Mail service” affects the runtime image selected for the lab; it does not change the generic CLI model.

docs.title: Safety Constraints
docs.text:
• Every remote check must target an owned or explicitly authorized service.
  • Production checks default to no OOM, UAF, crash, brute-force repetition, or arbitrary command.
  • The file-read marker is not placed in the validation URL, query, or traversal string, preventing input-reflection false positives.
  • Both controls must pass: the include sink returns the marker, while the normal safe endpoint returns only Hello World.
  • Docker labs use an internal network, unique Compose project, synthetic data, and automatic cleanup; --keep is for short manual inspection only.
  • Reports must distinguish “runtime only” from “runtime + gadget”.

docs.title: Out of Scope
docs.text:
• Scanning the internet or unauthorized hosts.
  • Reading real user mail, sessions, attachments, secrets, or production temporary files.
  • Restarting, patching, taking offline, or reconfiguring production.
  • Hiding a version banner and calling it patched; remediation must be verified by runtime version and released artifacts.
  • Treating scanner output, docker exec management-plane execution, or ordinary PHP page execution as unauthenticated RCE.

docs.title: CLI Tree
docs.text: ChatBug is an authorized vulnerability-validation CLI. The tree below is maintained from the real registered Click surface; before release, run chatbug --tree to verify the documented contract.

docs.title: Real Command Tree
docs.text:
chatbug
├── --help                                                                 # Show this message and exit.
├── --version                                                              # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree                                                                 # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
├── --tree-brief                                                           # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.
└── php2shell                                                              # PHP2Shell web checks and data-free lab proof.
    ├── lab                                                                # Disposable, data-free lab workflows.
    │   ├── docker-list --ssh-host TEXT --fpm-image TEXT --proof [list-tmp|cat-marker|list-and-marker] [--keep]  # Prove list/cat inside a data-free PHP-FPM lab with an intentional include sink.
    │   └── local-list                                                     # Run a complete positive/negative example in an in-process local lab.
    └── web                                                                # Checks for an ordinary owned website URL.
        └── check <URL> [--skip-multipart] [--skip-gadget-scan]            # Check version exposure, parser reachability, and common include gadgets.

docs.title: chatbug php2shell web check <URL>
docs.text:
Runs non-destructive checks against a website that you own or are explicitly authorized to test:

  1. reads the PHP version from Server / X-Powered-By and classifies it against fixed releases;
  2. sends an ordinary multipart POST to prove upload-parser reachability;
  3. probes a small fixed set of common page/file/include/path parameter shapes for an independent marker;
  4. emits JSON without sending OOM/UAF/crash payloads or executing system commands on the target.

Exit codes:

  • 0: the version banner indicates an affected range;
  • 3: checks completed, but an affected version was not proven or the version banner is hidden;
  • other non-zero codes: request or local execution errors.

Options:

  • --skip-multipart: perform only version/HTTP checks;
  • --skip-gadget-scan: skip common include-gadget probes and keep only version and parser-reachability evidence.

docs.title: chatbug php2shell lab local-list
docs.text:
Starts a temporary in-process HTTP lab and runs both positive and negative controls:

  • positive: the synthetic LFI include sink reads session upload-progress content and returns /tmp, chatbug-marker.txt, and a random marker;
  • negative: normal hello.php, even with the same path parameter, returns only Hello World;
  • no Docker, root, network, or real shell is required. This command is suitable for CI, documentation, and first reproduction.

docs.title: chatbug php2shell lab docker-list --ssh-host <host> [--fpm-image <image>]
docs.text:
Creates a one-off full-runtime lab on an owned SSH host with Docker:

  • exact PHP-FPM image plus Nginx;
  • internal Docker network with no published host port;
  • temporary webroot containing only Hello World and a lab-only include($_GET['page']);
  • only synthetic files are mounted; no production database, mail, user directory, credentials, logs, or attachments are attached;
  • the Compose project, network, and remote temporary directory are removed automatically.

--proof is a fixed allowlist and never accepts arbitrary commands:

proof Fixed lab action Acceptance list-tmp ls -la /tmp Returns the lab temporary-directory listing cat-marker cat /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt Returns a random synthetic marker list-and-marker ls -la /tmp; echo MARKER; cat /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt Returns the listing, MARKER, and random marker

--keep is only for manual inspection. A retained lab still has no public/host-published port.

docs.title: Evidence Interpretation
docs.text:
• Version exposure sets remediation priority but is not RCE.
  • Multipart HTTP 200 only proves parser reachability.
  • local-list proves the deterministic LFI/session-injection teaching chain inside the package.
  • docker-list proves that, on the same PHP-FPM runtime with an intentionally added lab gadget, file inclusion can reach fixed ls/cat actions.
  • Without a separate application LFI gadget, a memory-corruption CVE must not be described as “production RCE reproduced”.

docs.title: PHP2Shell Reproduction Lab
docs.text: This page explains how ChatBug safely reproduces the complete chain from PHP runtime risk plus an application LFI gadget to ls/cat output. The example uses the ordinary-website model; it does not reserve a product-specific CLI group for any one application.

docs.title: Evidence Boundary
docs.text:
PHP2Shell risk must be split into two layers:

  1. Runtime exposure: the HTTP SAPI uses an unfixed PHP version, or the multipart/upload-progress precondition is reachable. This supports upgrade and triage but does not prove command execution.
  2. End-to-end gadget: the application also exposes an attacker-controlled include/file-inclusion path that includes a session file and executes PHP code inside it. The lab's ls/cat result proves this layer.

ChatBug does not send the OOM/UAF/crash payloads for CVE-2026-109618/109619. The remote lab reproduces the deterministic traditional PHP session upload-progress plus LFI chain using an exact/digest-pinned PHP-FPM runtime matching the assessed service.

docs.title: Chain Overview
docs.text:
Unauthenticated multipart POST
  └─ PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS makes PHP write request metadata to a session file
      └─ The filename field carries <?php ... system(fixed command) ... ?>
          └─ The application exposes include($user_controlled_path)
              └─ It includes /tmp/sess_<PHPSESSID>
                  └─ The lab returns delimited ls/cat output

Missing any condition weakens the conclusion:

  • without an application LFI sink, only runtime/parser exposure is proven;
  • docker exec ... php is management-plane execution, not unauthenticated exploitation;
  • an ordinary PHP page reading a file does not prove that a remote attacker can execute commands.

docs.title: 1. Minimal Runnable Local Example
docs.text:
python -m pip install ChatBug
chatbug php2shell lab local-list

The command:

  • starts an in-process HTTP lab bound to a temporary 127.0.0.1 port;
  • sends an upload-progress multipart request;
  • requests the synthetic include sink;
  • requests the normal hello.php negative control;
  • closes the socket/thread and clears in-memory state on exit.

Successful result shape:

{
  "accepted": true,
  "positive_status": 200,
  "negative_status": 200,
  "positive_output": "/tmp\nchatbug-marker.txt\nCHATBUG_MARKER_EXAMPLE",
  "negative_body": "Hello World\n"
}

Acceptance conditions:

  • accepted=true;
  • positive output contains /tmp, chatbug-marker.txt, and the random marker;
  • negative output contains only Hello World.

The local lab does not start a system shell or real PHP; it is a deterministic teaching/regression chain inside the package. CI can run:

python -m pytest -q tests/test_php2shell.py

docs.title: 2. Full PHP-FPM/Nginx Isolated Lab
docs.text:
On an owned Docker host:

chatbug php2shell lab docker-list \
  --ssh-host <owned-docker-host> \
  [--fpm-image <digest-pinned-php-fpm-image>] \
  --proof list-and-marker

ChatBug creates a unique temporary directory under the remote $HOME/.chatarch/chatbug/labs/ and generates:

  • a exact PHP-FPM image;
  • Nginx proxying to PHP-FPM;
  • hello.php, which returns only Hello World;
  • vuln.php, which exists only in the lab and contains include($_GET['page']);
  • upload-progress/session settings;
  • an internal-only Docker network;
  • a one-shot Python client container.

It does not mount production databases, mail data, attachments, user directories, credentials, logs, or real session directories, and it publishes no host port.

docs.title: 3. Fixed Proof Modes
docs.text:
--proof does not accept arbitrary shell commands:

list-tmp         -> ls -la /tmp
cat-marker       -> cat /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt
list-and-marker  -> ls -la /tmp; echo MARKER; cat /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt

The default list-and-marker provides both a directory listing and unique file content, showing that:

  • the command executed inside the lab container;
  • the response read server-side /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt, not a reflected request value.

docs.title: 4. Positive and Negative Acceptance
docs.text:
On success, result.positive_output contains content like:

___START___
total 24
drwxrwxrwt 1 root root 4096 ... .
...
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root 32 ... chatbug-marker.txt
-rw------- 1 www-data www-data ... sess_lab...
MARKER
CHATBUG_MARKER_...
___END___

result.negative_output must be:

Hello World

accepted=true requires all of the following:

  • POST returns 200;
  • the positive include sink returns 200;
  • the negative normal page returns 200;
  • positive output contains this run's random marker;
  • negative output does not contain the marker;
  • the Compose project and remote temporary directory are removed successfully.

docs.title: 5. Ordinary Production Website Check
docs.text:
For a live service, run only the safe check:

chatbug php2shell web check https://owned-service.example/

Result fields:

Field Meaning verdict=vulnerable_version_exposed The version banner is affected; upgrade/confirm the actual SAPI evidence_tier=tier_2_parser_reachable An ordinary multipart request reaches the parsing path evidence_tier=tier_3_gadget_found A fixed probe returned an independent marker, evidence of an include gadget rce_or_file_read_proven=false File read or RCE is not proven

The command neither runs ls/cat in production nor sends memory-corruption payloads.

docs.title: 6. Follow-Up Remediation
docs.text:
1. Inventory every PHP SAPI serving real HTTP traffic: FPM, mod_php, FrankenPHP, LiteSpeed, etc. CLI versions are not Web-runtime evidence.
  2. Upgrade to the official fixed release and read back the new version header, package version, or container digest.
  3. Search for and remove unauthorized file-inclusion/path-construction sinks.
  4. Tighten upload handling, session save paths, temporary-directory permissions, and error exposure.
  5. Re-run web check after upgrade and rerun the positive/negative data-free lab.
  6. If compromise is suspected, inspect access logs, abnormal sessions, webshells, child processes, and outbound connections separately; vulnerability validation does not replace forensics.
